finding.headline: "The Milk-Supply Worrier"
finding.problem: "Is my baby getting enough? I'm scared my milk is disappearing. Everyone says 'eat oats and drink water' but I don't know the actual plan."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 28-yr-old breastfeeding mum convinced her supply is low; obsesses over protein + galactagogues; drinks fenugreek/ginger tea (per Minnesota toolkit) but unsure of diet.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Make More, Mama: The Breastfeeding Nutrition + Galactagogue Plan (Oats, Flax, Ginger, Pap)."". Verdict: PASSES (21/25)..
